rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one subjected to cutting
potential passive verb expressing non-occurrence of cutting
compound indicating one who has reached that state
compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that

items.question: Can absorption in that state prevent injury when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to cutting.
A person can be gone to that state with mind fixed on it.
Such absorption alters the effect of physical cutting.
items.inference: One absorbed in that state remains uncut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'that' depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Even while being cut, one who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that is not cut.
